The journal's scope covers: primary mathematics education, primary science education, primary Indonesian language and literature education, primary civics education, primary social studies education, primary arts education, primary religious education, primary physical education, and primary school administration and management.

Scope:
Journal of Automotive Engineering Education is a peer-reviewed journal dedicated to advancing knowledge and innovation in automotive engineering education and technical and vocational education and training (TVET). The journal provides a scholarly platform for researchers, academics, educators, practitioners, and policymakers to disseminate original research articles, literature reviews, and case studies that contribute to the improvement of automotive education, vocational learning, and professional practice.

The journal's scope covers automotive engineering education and pedagogy; curriculum development in automotive vocational education; teaching and learning strategies in automotive education; instructional media and educational technology for automotive learning; assessment and evaluation in automotive education; teacher professional development; competency-based education and training; industry collaboration and work-based learning; and workforce development in the automotive vocational sector.
